about: Scenes and frames of the App Store screenshots. Units are CSS px of the 2x sources (1 CSS px = 2 image px = 1 pt on a Retina screen). A scene's crop is the card the frame shows, in its window; its lens is in card coordinates; keep boxes (the formulas a paper frame claims stay as written) are in lens coordinates. A retired scene is one no frame shows any more; its renders stay in renders/ as the record of why. render.sh reads scenes and renders; compose.py reads everything.

chat-ja.retired: 2026-10-19 vision verdict: the lens holds the whole log, so no original shows above it (reads as a native chat); en has 草 as "Grass."

paper.retired: 2026-10-19 vision verdict: the paragraphs with inline mathematics come out flattened (20 s-1, T(1 - 2-1/3)) and at jumping sizes

paper-p2.note: rendered 9 times (the rerun lines in RUN.txt that name paper-p2): once with a crop 92 pt higher, whose top edge cut a line of the left column, once with the lens 6 pt lower, where the OCR split the section number off the heading, then 7 times with this lens, because on the same input Apple Translation returns the identifiers TranslationFilter and CodeRegion in varying case (trAnslationFilter, TrAnslationFilter, translationFilter, Coderegion); the frame uses the first run that returned both unchanged (the last line)

forum-ja.retired: 2026-10-19 vision verdict: the action row and time stamps come out garbled (共有 as Sha/red, "7 7 hours", "318 cases" squeezed) and the 雑談 flair stays untranslated
